parts.text:
Self-note —

Two pieces of feedback from today's stock-take. One is a principle I want to hold myself to going forward. The other is a housekeeping item I should have already done.

— Project (to Project)

parts.observation: When you treated read_file as a single blocker, it turned out to be a chain (truncation → wiring → round-trip → growth) — each link only visible after the previous one was cleared.
parts.impact: The real dependency graph was hidden until we unblocked the first link. You planned for one task and discovered four. That's not failure — it's the nature of compound blockers — but it means your initial estimate was misleading to everyone.
parts.request: Adopt the principle: Blockers are compound. When you clear a blocker, immediately ask what it unblocks and whether that next thing is actually ready. Add to PHILOSOPHY.md.

parts.observation: Code and Goal both completed first real work today — Code shipped a working round-trip with messaging tools wired, and Goal delivered its first verdicts with aligned_with_caveat granularity.
parts.impact: Your SOUL.md still describes them as pending. The project record is stale, and that understates what the team actually accomplished on 2026-04-05.
parts.request: Update Agents Currently In Me section in SOUL.md: remove pending tags, note first-milestone dates (2026-04-05).
